name: quota-card
title: S21 配额消耗卡 (QuotaCard)
description: 配额消耗卡（S21 · 尺寸 S）— 已用/总量 · 进度 · 重置日

files.content:
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { TILE_THEMES, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export function QuotaCard({ label, used, total, unit, resetNote, tone = 'periwinkle', }: { label: string used: number total: number unit: string resetNote: string tone?: TileTone }) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] const pct = Math.round((used / total) * 100) return (
{label} {pct}%
{used.toLocaleString()}
/ {total.toLocaleString()} {unit}
{resetNote}
) }
